title: Cleanse Me, O Loofah, But Leave My Soul
author: The Bard of Bizarre
blurb: She said, "Don't touch the pink one. It's mine!" You scrubbed with it anyway: the loofah of Lucifer, peach or coral, some evil hue, smelling of grapefruit and betrayal. Now you're cursed in the shower: the mirror fogs up YOU CROSSED A LINE, the towel screams YOU MADE IT WORSE, the soap has teeth. Gather bath salt for the brine, pick rosemary in a forest-dark store aisle where wild loofahs grow on the vine, buy a loofah of your own, light six candles at home, and cleanse Scrubbus Maximus, the demon sponge, back into the pink one. Shareware from The Sofa BBS, a goth rock song by The Bard of Bizarre (lyrics and music: credit pending; title and cover art drawn for the game by Claude Opus 5.5).
